purpose: compact evidence that Engineering-OS routing actually influenced execution

record.entry_point: exact Engineering-OS file first used for this decision
record.route_key: exact key from EXECUTION-FAST-PATH.json or ROUTING-MAP branch
record.verification: deterministic/evidence gate used to accept the result

rules: record decisions, not every file read or tool call
whole-project qualification must emit required records before final status
when delegation is skipped after the trigger, use only an allowed skip reason from EXECUTION-FAST-PATH.json
shared project context alone is not a sufficient skip reason
do not include secrets or private data
an agent/tool invocation is not verification by itself
